colophon.no-custom-colophon: No colophon is available for this application yet.

exact-match.title: Exact Match
exact-match.description: Use quotation marks to search for an exact phrase or word combination.

wildcard.title: Wildcard Search
wildcard.description: Use an asterisk (*) to replace multiple characters within a word.

boolean.title: Boolean Operators
boolean.description: Use AND, OR and NOT to refine your search query.

filters.title: Using Filters
filters.description: Use the filters on the side to refine your results.

relevance.title: Relevance Sorting
relevance.description: Search results are automatically sorted by relevance using Elasticsearch. The most relevant results are shown at the top.

ocr.title: OCR Text Recognition
ocr.description: Newspaper text was processed with OCR (optical character recognition). This allowed us to make a large collection searchable, but the text may at times contain recognition errors.

referral.title: This site
referral.description: Here you can find a number of concrete search tips. Do you want to know more about how this website works? On our main site you can find a detailed explanation of the new search interface.
